ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; approximately 90% dark to 10% light distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray mass with high-contrast white circular blobs concentrated heavily at the distal tips and scattered as isolated focal points throughout the central ventral region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an approximate 30-degree aperture dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serration pattern with variable pixel amplitudes extracted along the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve extending from the median notch toward the upward-tilted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of white circular pixel rings localized at both the left and right distal tips; secondary distribution of isolated circular marks throughout the fluke interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical and diagonal light-colored linear pixel disruptions (scratches) primarily on the right lobe and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral margins and numerous circular depigmentation marks consistent with prior barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: The left tip displays a higher-density accumulation of barnacle rosettes compared to the right, resulting in a more irregular distal profile.
